summary: Retest of iteration 3 artifacts. Re-ran the 3 backend test files and all 8 named browser checks unchanged. 8/8 browser checks passed. Backend: 8 of 9 test functions passed; the previously filed bug is STILL PRESENT and unfixed: test_admin_cannot_see_own_qa_named_product fails because routers/products.py still applies the public QA-name title filter to admin-authenticated GET /products and GET /products/{id}. Public catalog remains exactly the 4 approved products after all checks.

bugs.title: Admin cannot see/manage their own product if its title starts with tscheck/test/debug/placeholder (still unfixed, regression-checked)
bugs.description: routers/products.py still applies the public QA-name exclusion filter (title regex ^(tscheck|test|debug|placeholder)) to GET /products and GET /products/{id} for EVERY caller including an authenticated admin. Admin POST-create succeeds (201) but the created product is absent from the admin's own authenticated GET /products list and returns 404 on GET /products/{id}, so the admin UI cannot list, view, edit, or verify it (only blind DELETE-by-known-id works). This directly contradicts the spec_deviation clarifying QA-named products must be visible to authenticated administrators for cleanup/management. Unaffected: public/customer-facing catalog correctly excludes QA-named titles, and the approved 4-product public catalog is intact.
bugs.evidence: cd /app/backend && python -m pytest -q tests/test_tscheck_catalog_integrity.py -> 1 failed, 8 passed. Failing assertion: admin_client.post('/products', title='tscheck-catalog-visibility-dbaf7257') -> 201 (id=518bf930-...); client.get('/products') (public, unauthenticated) correctly excludes id (pass); admin_client.get('/products') -> 200 but returned id list [be39b679.., 4803bc76.., 31194083.., f60a8278..] does NOT contain the new id; admin_client.get('/products/518bf930-...') -> 404 'Product not found'. Live curl confirms public GET /products still returns exactly the 4 approved titles (Luxury Nazakat Collection, Aira Pure Kota Doria Angrakha, Vaaya Pure Kota Doria Anarkali, Sang-e-Mar-Mar — Rose Edition).

action_items.detail: Scope the QA-name title filter in routers/products.py (list_products and get_product) to unauthenticated/customer requests only, or add a dedicated admin-authenticated listing path that is never filtered, so admins can see, edit and delete their own QA/test-named products through the Admin UI. This is a carry-over from iteration 3, still unresolved.
